question: How do I apply for financial aid?
answer: Complete the FAFSA online and submit any extra documents the financial aid office asks for.

question: When is the FAFSA deadline?
answer: The priority FAFSA deadline is in early spring so file as early as possible to get the most aid.

question: How do I check my financial aid status?
answer: Log into the student portal and open the financial aid tab to see your awards and missing documents.

question: Can I get a scholarship as a current student?
answer: Current students can apply for department and university scholarships through the scholarship portal each year.

question: How do I drop a class?
answer: You can drop a class in the registration system before the drop deadline without it showing on your transcript.

question: How do I register for classes?
answer: Register for classes during your assigned registration time using the course registration system.

question: What happens if a class is full?
answer: If a class is full you can join the waitlist and you will be added automatically if a seat opens up.

question: How do I withdraw from a course after the deadline?
answer: After the drop deadline you need to file a late withdrawal request with your college and it will show a W on your transcript.

question: How many credit hours is full time?
answer: Undergraduates need at least 12 credit hours per semester to be considered full time.

question: When can I move into my dorm?
answer: University Housing posts move in dates for each dorm before the start of the semester.

question: How do I apply for campus housing?
answer: Apply for campus housing through the housing portal and pay the application fee to pick a room.

question: Can I change my dorm room?
answer: Room change requests open a few weeks into the semester and depend on available space.

question: What should I bring to my dorm?
answer: Bring bedding and towels and a laundry basket and check the housing website for items that are not allowed.

question: How do meal plans work?
answer: Meal plans give you a set number of swipes and dining dollars to use at dining halls on campus.

question: Where can I eat on campus late at night?
answer: Some dining halls and campus cafes stay open late on weeknights so check the dining hours page.

question: Can I change my meal plan?
answer: You can change your meal plan during the first few weeks of the semester through the housing portal.

question: Where can I get tutoring?
answer: Free tutoring is offered at the learning center and through many academic departments.

question: Can I get help with math?
answer: The math department runs drop in tutoring for calculus and other intro math courses.

question: Is there help for writing papers?
answer: The writing center helps with essays and research papers and you can book an appointment online.

question: Where can I print on campus?
answer: You can print at campus libraries and computer labs using your student ID.

question: How do I get a new student ID card?
answer: Visit the ID center with a photo ID to replace a lost student ID card for a small fee.

question: How do I reset my campus password?
answer: Reset your campus password on the IT help website or call the IT help desk for support.

question: How do I connect to campus wifi?
answer: Connect to the campus wifi network and log in with your university username and password.

question: Where can I see a doctor on campus?
answer: The campus health center offers appointments for students and you can book online or call.

question: Does the university offer counseling?
answer: The counseling center offers free sessions for students and you can schedule an appointment by phone.

question: Do I need health insurance as a student?
answer: Students are automatically enrolled in the student health insurance plan unless they waive it with their own coverage.

question: How do I ride the campus bus?
answer: Students ride the campus buses for free by showing their student ID when getting on.

question: Where can I park on campus?
answer: Buy a parking permit from campus parking services to park in student lots.

question: How do I find an internship?
answer: The career center posts internships on the job portal and holds career fairs every semester.

question: Can someone review my resume?
answer: Career advisors review resumes during drop in hours at the career center.

question: Where can I study on campus?
answer: Campus libraries and the student union have quiet study spaces and rooms you can reserve.

question: Where is the campus gym?
answer: The ARC is the main campus gym and students can use it for free with their student ID.
